Datatable.LocalizationPair: AN ANCIENT BEING, PERHAPS UNIQUE IN THIS UNIVERSE, HAS WATCHED THE GALAXY GROW THROUGH IT'S DREAMS DURING IT'S MILLENNIA LONG STASIS. ALL RECORDS OF THE UNHOLY WAR THAT CRIPPLED THE WATCHER HAVE BEEN STRICKEN FROM HISTORY. ALTHOUGH IT CLAIMS TO HAVE NO MEMORY OF THE EVENT, THE SCARS UPON THE GALAXY ARE EVIDENT. AWOKEN BY THE SIGNAL OF THE ETERNUM, ALTHOUGH NOT FULLY HEALED, THE WATCHER BEGINS IT'S TASK OF GALACTIC ASCENSION.
THE WATCHER'S CONSTRUCTS ARE SEMI-SENTIENT, AUTONOMOUS SERVITORS THAT AID IN CONSTRUCTION AND LOGISTICS FOR THE ASCENSION.
Constructs must be built in the Construction Queue; they do not "grow" normally.
CONSTRUCTS CAN ABOSRB THE GENETIC MATERIAL OF OTHER LIFEFORMS TO ENHANCE THEIR FUNCTIONS AND ABILITIES. ABSORPTION REQUIRES THE SACRIFICE OF SOME SUBSERVIENTS
Constructs can abosrb the genetic material of other lifeforms to enhance their functions and abilities. Absorption requires the sacrifice of some lesser species.
Systems which only have Riftborn/CONSTRUCT affinity populations don't have System Growth

HOMEWORLD OF THE WATCHER, ARCADIA IS A LUXURIOUS GARDEN WORLD; FILLED WITH ANCIENT TECHNOLOGY AND LIFE. IT ORBITS AN ARTIFICIAL STAR PURPOSE-BUILT TO PROVIDE THE ENERGY REQUIRED FOR THE ASCENSION. THE WATCHER HAS CALLED ARCADIA HOME SINCE ITS ESTABLISHMENT AS THE HOST; THE SANCTUM FROM WHICH THE CYCLE BEGINS... AND ENDS.
DURING YOUR MILLENNIA LONG STASIS THE GALAXY HAS FLOURISHED WITH LIFE. THE CYCLE MUST CONTINUE. PREPARE THE GALAXY FOR ASCENSION.
THE WATCHER'S CONSTRUCTS ARE SEMI-SENTIENT, AUTONOMOUS SERVITORS THAT AID IN CONSTRUCTION AND LOGISTICS FOR THE ASCENSION.

THE PRIME CONSTRUCT HAS BEEN THE CARETAKER OF THE HOST SINCE IT'S INCEPTION. WHILST THE WATCHER WAS IN STASIS, THE PRIME CONSTRUCT OVERSAW THE MAINTENANCE OF THE PLANET; ENSURING EVERY MEASURE WAS TAKEN TO RESTORE THE WATCHER TO IT'S FORMER STRENGTH.
THE OVERSEER FOCUSES ON FLEET WARFARE AND INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION. THE OVERSEER SHIP IS ORIENTED TOWARDS ATTACK, CARRYING MORE WEAPONS MODULES TO PACK AN ADDITIONAL PUNCH FOR THE FLEET.
THIS BRANCH CONTAINS THE CONSTRUCT SPECIFIC SKILLS.
THIS BRANCH CONTAINS THE OVERSEER SPECIFIC SKILLS.
THIS BRANCH CONTAINS ADVANCED GENERAL SKILLS.
CREATION OF A CONSTUCT IS A RESOURCE INTENSIVE PROJECT; HOWEVER THE BENEFITS THAT A CONSTRUCT PROVIDES FAR OUTWEIGH THE COST OF PRODUCTION
DEDICATING ALL INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT TOWARDS THE CONSTRUCTION OF BATTLEFIELD ASSETS MAY DELAY INFRASTRUCTURE DEVELOPMENT, BUT IT DOES PERMIT THE RAPID ENHANCEMENT OF MILITARY FORCES
Unlocks additional [Strat01titaniumColored] Module Slots for SWORD Hulls
Unlocks additional [Strat02hyperiumColored] Module Slots for SHIELD hulls
Unlocks additional [Strat03adamantianColored] Module Slots for MARTYR Hulls

ROLE: FLAGSHIP PERSONAL FLAGSHIP OF THE WATCHER'S PRIME CONSTRUCT
ROLE: COLONIZATION TRANSPORTS COLONIZATION EQUIPMENT TO STAR SYSTEMS
ROLE: EXPLORATION TRANSMITS GALACTIC DATA TO THE WATCHER FOR ANALYSIS
ROLE: ATTACK PRIMARY ATTACK SHIP FOR SKIRMISHES AND ESCORTS
ROLE: SUPPORT PRIMARY SUPPORT SHIP FOR SKIRMISHES AND ESCORTS

ROLE: INVASION HEAVY SUPPORT SHIP FOR INVASION AND SECURITY
ROLE: COLONIZATION THE SHIP THAT LED THE CONSTRUCTS FROM DARK-SPACE, OFF-COURSE AND ERRING IN SPACE UNTIL PROXIMITY ALARMS ENDED THE WATCHER'S CRYOGENIC SLEEP
ROLE: CARRIER SUPER-HEAVY CARRIER FOR GALACTIC ASCENSION
ROLE: COLONIZATION FULFILLS THE ROLE OF A SYSTEM BASE FOR THE CONSTRUCTS, ANCHORING ON THOSE DEEMED WORTHY OF ASCENSION
ROLE: LEECHER ALLOWS RAIDING OF SYSTEMS FOR ESSENCE
ROLE: ENTWINER ENABLES COLONIZATION OF OTHER SYSTEMS VIA THE VINE NETWORK
CHAPTER ONE: THE ASCENSION BEGINS - PART ONE

AS THE FIRST CONSTRUCTS SETTLE ON NEW WORLDS RIPE WITH RESOURCES; SENSORS INDICATE HOSTILE ASSETS ORBITING NEARBY SYSTEMS. IF THESE PIRATES REVEAL OUR PRESENCE OR SUBDUE A CONSTRUCT ASSET, IT COULD BE DETRIMENTAL TO THE ASCENSION'S PLANNING. PURGE THESE PATHETIC LIFE-FORMS FROM EXISTANCE SO THAT THE ASCENSION MAY CONTINUE UNIMPEDED.

ELIMINATE THE PIRATES As the first Constructs settle on new worlds ripe with resources; sensors indicate hostile assets orbiting nearby systems. If these Pirates reveal our presence or subdue a Construct asset, it could be detrimental to the Ascension's planning. Purge these pathetic life-forms from existance so that the Ascension may continue unimpeded.
Destroy the indicated Pirate fleets in or near your home constellation.
All other fleets must be eradicated to ensure the safety of your new home.
WITH THIS FILTH PURGED FROM THE GALAXY, THE TERRITORY SURRONDING THE HOST IS SECURE, AND WE CAN BEGIN SEEKING NEW LIFE TO EXPAND THE CONSTRUCTS PROWESS.

OBTAIN ADDITIONAL MATERIAL FOR THE ASCENSION. With this filth purged from the galaxy, the territory surrounding the Host is secure, and we can begin seeking new life and resources to expand the Constructs prowess. Local scans indicate high concentrations of genetic and material resources, however only one can be the focus at this time.
Brainwash a new Minor Civilization to learn more about this galaxy.
Use the "Assimilate" Diplomacy Action to convert the Minor Civilization. However, you can invade the Minor Civilization's system, asserting control over them instead.
